explication: SQLFluff is a configurable, dialect-flexible SQL linter with CLI and Python API entry points. A typical run loads configuration, renders templated SQL, lexes and parses it using a dialect grammar, evaluates lint rules, and reports violations or applies fixes. The tree and README establish broad dialect, templater, plugin, and optional Rust-parser capabilities; sampled source confirms parts of the parser, rule context, and query analysis, but not every orchestration call, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
